verdict.title: brisk ai agent coin
verdict.cap: an "AI agent" with no agent anywhere on the site or in the code: capped at LIKELY LARP
verdict.headline: Brisk says an AI agent trades for holders. The site is a static page with a typing animation, there is no code, and the dev sold his whole bag 20 seconds after launch.
verdict.call: The 'AI agent' is a static page; the dev sold 5.1% in 20 s and a bundle wallet still holds 7.4%.
verdict.eli5: The coin says a robot trades for you. There is no robot: the website just pretends to type. The person who made the coin sold right away.
verdict.summary: The post and the site describe an autonomous trading agent that shares profits with holders. The sandbox browser found a single static page: the "live trades" panel loops the same six lines on every load and no request leaves the page. The linked GitHub repo is empty. On chain, the dev bought 5.1% in the create slot and sold all of it 20 seconds later; a second wallet bought 9.0% in the same slot and still holds 7.4%. Mint and freeze are revoked.
verdict.watch: Watch whether bundle wallet euza…yc4G sells the 7.4% it still holds.
